title: The $1.1 Trillion Credit Card Debt Spike

scenes.narration: Have you noticed your credit card balance creeping higher?

visual.text: The $1.1 Trillion Credit Card Debt Spike

scenes.narration: In January 2015, credit card balances at US banks sat at $625.5 billion.
By October 2026, those balances surged to a record $1.1 trillion.
That is an increase of 76% over the last decade.
The full story is on the channel.

visual.text: Debt is rising faster than ever.

scenes.narration: Do you remember when Americans were saving record amounts?
In April 2020, the personal saving rate hit an incredible 31.8%.
Fast forward to September 2026, and that rate has cratered to just 3.8%.
That is an 88% drop from the pandemic peak.
The full story is on the channel.

title: The Wage vs. Debt Reality Check

scenes.narration: Higher hourly pay should help, right? But the math is complicated.

visual.text: The Wage vs. Debt Reality Check

scenes.narration: Since January 2015, average hourly pay for non-managers grew 57%.
However, household debt service payments still consume 11.1% of disposable income.
Rising wages are being absorbed by these persistent debt obligations.
The full story is on the channel.
